claims.claim_text: Rigetti's wholly owned Indian subsidiary received an $8.4 million purchase order from India's C-DAC (Centre for Development of Advanced Computing) in January 2026 to deliver a 108-qubit quantum computer for installation in 2H 2026 in Bengaluru.
claims.subject: Rigetti Computing India P L
claims.source_quote: In January 2026, Rigetti Computing India P L, a wholly owned subsidiary of Rigetti Computing, Inc., announced that it received an $8.4 million purchase order to deliver a 108-qubit quantum computer to C-DAC. The system will be installed on-premises at C-DAC s Bengaluru center and is expected to be deployed in the second half of 2026.

claims.claim_text: In February 2025 Rigetti entered into a Collaboration Agreement with Quanta Computer under which each party commits to invest at least $250 million over five years in quantum computing; in April 2025 Quanta purchased ~$35M of Rigetti common stock at ~$11.59/share.
